table.name: conductor
table.purpose: Catalog of conductors, one row per conductor, with age, nationality and years of work; referenced by orchestra via Conductor_ID.

Age.name: Age
Age.description: Age of the conductor in years (40-63).

Conductor_ID.name: Conductor ID
Conductor_ID.description: Primary key identifying the conductor; referenced by orchestra.Conductor_ID.

Name.name: Name
Name.description: Full name of the conductor (e.g. Pierre Boulez, Seiji Ozawa).

Nationality.name: Nationality
Nationality.description: Nationality of the conductor as a country code: USA, UK, France.

Year_of_Work.name: Years of work
Year_of_Work.description: Number of years the conductor has worked (values 6-21). The name suggests a year, but the values are small counts, so it is more likely a count of years of work/experience.

table.name: orchestra
table.purpose: Catalog of orchestras, one row per orchestra, with its conductor, record company, record format and founding year.

Conductor_ID.name: Conductor ID
Conductor_ID.description: Foreign key to conductor.Conductor_ID; the conductor of this orchestra.

Major_Record_Format.name: Major record format
Major_Record_Format.description: Physical format of the orchestra's major recordings: CD, CD / LP, or DVD.

Orchestra.name: Orchestra name
Orchestra.description: Full name of the orchestra (e.g. Chicago Symphony Orchestra).

Orchestra_ID.name: Orchestra ID
Orchestra_ID.description: Primary key identifying the orchestra; referenced by performance.Orchestra_ID.

Record_Company.name: Record company
Record_Company.description: Record label the orchestra records with (e.g. Decca Records, EMI).

table.name: performance
table.purpose: One row per broadcast performance/episode of a TV show (auditions, semi-finals, final), with date, ratings, audience share and weekly rank, linked to an orchestra.

Date.name: Date
Date.description: Date of the broadcast, day and month only (e.g. '10 June'); year not stored.

Official_ratings_(millions).name: Official ratings (millions)
Official_ratings_(millions).description: Official audience rating of the broadcast in millions of viewers (5.2-11.58).

Orchestra_ID.name: Orchestra ID
Orchestra_ID.description: Foreign key to orchestra.Orchestra_ID; the orchestra featured in this performance.

Performance_ID.name: Performance ID
Performance_ID.description: Primary key identifying the performance/episode; referenced by show.Performance_ID.

Share.name: Audience share
Share.description: Audience share of the broadcast as a percentage string (e.g. '28.0%').

Type.name: Episode type
Type.description: Type of episode: 'Auditions 1'-'Auditions 5', 'Semi-final 3', 'Live final results', 'Series average'.

Weekly_rank.name: Weekly rank
Weekly_rank.description: Weekly TV ranking of the broadcast as a number (1-13), with 'TBC' meaning to be confirmed.

table.name: show
table.purpose: One row per live show/event tied to a performance, with venue, attendance and result.

Attendance.name: Attendance
Attendance.description: Number of attendees at the show (555-2431).

If_first_show.name: Venue
If_first_show.description: Despite the name, values are Scottish football stadium names (St. Mirren Park, Fir Park, Glebe Park, Hampden Park), so this is most likely the venue of the show; possibly it originally indicated whether it was the first show at that venue, but the evidence supports venue.

Performance_ID.name: Performance ID
Performance_ID.description: Foreign key to performance.Performance_ID; the performance this show belongs to.

Result.name: Result
Result.description: Boolean-like flag, T/F; likely whether the show had a positive result (e.g. win/success), but the exact meaning is not determinable from the data.
